It looks like the outputted string here is padded with a space, but a space is also placed between the symbol and the formatted version string in the `segment.set_value()` call.

It looks like this is inserting 2x spaces for me:

body: I would suggest adding `"rustlang"` as an option here. ☝️
I was using the vscode and it was only showing one space but in iterm shows two. I guess there is some differences in how it renders spaces based on the terminal, good to know!
